description: This file contains the implementation of a parser for .po localization files, including methods for parsing lines, unescaping strings, and building culture dictionary records.

classes.name: PoParser
classes.description: A class that parses .po localization files into culture records.

classes.name: PoParser.DictionaryRecordBuilder
classes.description: A helper class for building culture dictionary records during parsing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a TextReader stream of a .po file into culture records.

methods.name: Unescape
methods.description: Converts escape sequences in strings to their literal characters.

methods.name: TrimQuote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string if present.

methods.name: ParseLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of a .po file into a context and content.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the current value in the record builder based on the parsing context.

methods.name: AppendText
methods.description: Appends text to the current message ID, context, or translation in the record builder.

methods.name: BuildRecordAndReset
methods.description: Builds a CultureDictionaryRecord from the current builder state and resets the builder.
